Meta tags and viewport
Metadata provides information about the document. The viewport declaration helps mobile
meta charset එක character encoding එක define කරනවා. viewport එක mobile screen එකට
A mobile shop should use the device width instead of a wide virtual viewport.
Read the numbered stages from top to bottom. head → charset; browser → responsive layout.

<head>
 <meta charset="UTF-8">
 <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
 <meta name="description" content="Find books online">
 <title>Book Shop</title>
</head>
Expected result: Browser tab shows Book Shop; CSS can adapt to device width.
Interview question: Why use the viewport meta tag?
Answer: It makes responsive layouts use the device-width viewport.
Practice: Test a page with and without viewport metadata in mobile emulation.
